title: Thermodynamic prediction of RNA cellular activity from sequence via conformational ensembles.
authors: Geng, Ainan; Roy, Rohit; Ken, Megan; Li, Linshu; Chime, Alicia; Abou Assi, Hala; Liu, Bei; Bou-Nader, Charles; Lee, Yeongjoon; Zhang, Jinwei; Herschlag, Daniel; Goff, Stephen P; Al-Hashimi, Hashim M
one_liner_zh: 该文通过NMR和热力学框架预测RNA构象ensemble对蛋白结合及细胞活性的影响，虽涉及RNA-蛋白互作但非TF-DNA体系，且方法以实验为主、计算预测为辅，与课题关联有限。
abstract: Despite advances in structure prediction from sequence, predicting cellular activity requires conformational ensembles that capture propensities to form functionally active states. Such ensembles remain difficult to measure and even harder to predict. Here, we systematically altered the HIV-1 transactivation response element (TAR) RNA sequence to change its propensity to adopt a functional versus inactive secondary structure and quantified these propensities using proton chemical exchange saturation transfer ((1)H CEST) NMR without isotopic labeling. Minor sequence changes shifted the active-state propensity by  approximately 500-fold, quantitatively predicting 125- to 300-fold changes in binding to the RNA-binding region of Tat and cellular transactivation. These propensities could be inferred from secondary-structure prediction algorithms and incorporated into a thermodynamic framework to quantitatively predict how sequence changes alter protein-binding affinity and cellular activity in this well-characterized system. Our findings establish a quantitative thermodynamic framework that links the RNA sequence to cellular activity through conformational ensembles, setting the stage for more generalized predictions as computational ensemble modeling continues to advance.
abstract_zh: 尽管在从序列预测结构方面取得了进展，但预测细胞活性需要能够捕捉形成功能活性状态倾向的构象集合。此类集合仍难以测量，更难以预测。在此，我们系统性地改变了HIV-1反式激活反应元件（TAR）RNA序列，以改变其采用功能性与非活性二级结构的倾向，并利用质子化学交换饱和转移（(1)H CEST）NMR无需同位素标记即可量化这些倾向。微小的序列变化使活性状态倾向改变了约500倍，定量预测了与Tat RNA结合区域结合及细胞反式激活的125至300倍变化。这些倾向可从二级结构预测算法中推断，并纳入热力学框架，以定量预测序列变化如何改变该特征明确系统中的蛋白质结合亲和力和细胞活性。我们的发现建立了一个定量热力学框架，通过构象集合将RNA序列与细胞活性联系起来，为随着计算集合建模的持续进步实现更广泛的预测奠定了基础。
